summary: Routes, dashboards, reports, tools, sharing a chart, settings sections and the command palette.

src/dashboards/layouts.js.note: All of it, with newId injectable so the fixtures check the web's ids exactly. Deliberate differences, all in input the app never produces (pinned by LayoutsBehaviour): names Object.prototype carries are not card types or templates (the web's plain-object lookups keep them, and then throws resetting such a dashboard); resetting a dashboard whose template no table has gives the overview's cards, as dashboardFromTemplate made them, where the web throws; non-string template or type values in a stored layout are dropped where the web keeps them; a registry rule with no sizes and no default gives a card size "" where the web leaves `size` out.

src/posting/routes.js.note: All of it. One deliberate difference, in addresses the app never makes: the web looks a page up in a plain object, so names Object.prototype carries ('constructor', 'toString', '__proto__') count as pages there ('/posting/constructor' is page 'constructor', for which PostingPage.jsx has no real page); here only the table's own keys name a page, so such an address is missing. Reported as a web bug; RoutesInheritedNames pins it.

src/reports/annotations.js.note: All of it, over VirgaCore's KeyValueStore with the web's key and byte-exact JSON. Ids are injected (`id:`; Annotations.newId gives the web's form, n + the time in base 36 + four random base-36 digits). Deliberate differences, in input the app never writes: a day must be a string (the web would keep ['2026-10-03'], which String() reads as that day); and a label cut at 80 UTF-16 units through an emoji keeps U+FFFD here where the web keeps the lone half surrogate and writes it as \ud83d (both read back as U+FFFD).

src/reports/models.js.note: All of it. The archive the models read is ReportArchive (did, handle, the context's nowMs and VirgaArchive's ArchiveData); local time, the locale, the first day of the week and the clock are ReportFormats, the active ones by default. localeCompare (the ties in the Content report and Lists you're on) is Support/JSCollation.swift, ICU's root order over a table read from Node's own collator (ios/scripts/generate-collation-table.mjs, held to Node by insights.collation); scripts the table doesn't cover sort after it by code point. The cache keeps the web's key and limit, plus the zone and the clock (the web never keys on the zone). Two deliberate differences, in input the app never has: a list whose purpose is a name Object.prototype carries ('constructor') ranks as an unknown purpose (3) where the web's plain-object lookup gives NaN; and rows are typed (VirgaArchive's rows), so a field of the wrong type reads as absent.

src/reports/useAnnotations.js.note: useAnnotations is AnnotationsModel (@MainActor @Observable): list, add(day, label), remove(id), each reading and writing the store as the hook does; the window's 'virga:annotations-changed' event is AnnotationsChanges, which every model for the DID hears. useChartMarks is AnnotationsModel.chartMarks(archive, series, unit, milestones:) (and Annotations.chartMarks), the milestones cached per archive revision under the web's key.

src/shell/commands.js.note: All of it. TERMS_PATH and PRIVACY_PATH are VirgaSession's LegalVersion.termsPath and privacyPath. Null where the app's tables always have a value reads as missing: a period with key null (the web writes `period:null`, arg null, and current true when no period is in use) or a Defense page with title null (the web's keywords start "null", here "undefined", as for a missing one).

src/shell/shortcuts.js.note: Every function is ported, over values instead of the DOM: isTypingTarget, isNewPostShortcut, isMacPlatform, paletteShortcutLabel, paletteShortcutAria and isPaletteShortcut read a KeyEvent, its KeyTarget and a Navigator (Shortcuts.swift). What the web reads from the document (the keydown event, event.target as an element, navigator.platform) is UI: VirgaUI's shell (the Shell.jsx port) turns a hardware keyboard's key presses (UIKeyCommand / .onKeyPress) and where focus is into those values, and works out inDialog from what it presents.

src/tools/interactionModel.js.note: All of it; nothing in it reads the network (InteractionLookup.jsx resolves a typed handle itself, VirgaUI). The web's `self` is `isSelf`. The timeline runs to the archive's nowMs, or the `nowMs:` given, or the device clock (the web's Date.now()). kindsLine takes the byKind entries in the object's order (`entries:`; integer-like keys first, as Object.keys orders them) or a dictionary (unknown kinds then go by name). Deliberate differences, in input the app never has: kinds and directions are looked up as own keys, so 'toString' gives no phrase (the web's plain-object lookup returns the inherited function) and an unknown kind is never counted in totals (the web's totals['constructor'] is a function); an event at a time outside Date's range gets at "" where the web's toISOString throws.

src/tools/registry.js.note: All of it. The ACCESS table it re-exports from src/components/AccessBadge.jsx is ported in Components/AccessBadge.swift, whose header names both files; AccessBadge.jsx's own entry (ui-shell) is still pending: its AccessLine is a view, VirgaUI's.
